name: Alano Club
notes:
Directions
Where is the Blue Jay Alano Club located?

Our physical address is 27175 CA-189, Lake Arrowhead, CA 92352.
Our cabin is tucked away for privacy, hidden from the main street, please follow these steps to find us:
1) Enter the large parking lot shared by the pet store and the former Rite Aid.
2) Drive past these storefronts toward the back of the lot.
3) Continue until the parking lot dead-ends.
4) Look just past the mini bridge on your left-hand side—you will see our cabin with the green deck and stairs.
